_comment: Individual source values reviewed by hand and found wrong. Keyed by food id; a nutrient set to null is dropped (missing beats wrong). Every entry says why. Applied after the automatic peer-outlier check (consumer/qa.py).

greek-yogurt-2-fat-plain-3b5a16._why: CNF 7469 lists 282.9 mg calcium per 100 g, likely a per-serving or entry error. Every other plain Greek yogurt across the 9 sources is 100-126 mg (strained yogurt loses calcium with the whey); set to the peer median, 115 mg, so the food doesn't count as zero.
